text:
maria: noticing a sharp p95 remote_write latency and a spike in series churn from the gpu-exporter fleet, started ~10:40 UTC. dashboards show series_added_per_second jump x6
jonathan: saw this too, lots of new series with label gpu_driver_version and gpu_uuid short ids, cardinality explosion in prod-west2
lee: any recent rollout for the exporter or node drivers?
maria: kube events show a node image-rollout CI job completed at 10:35, but exporter daemonset was not changed. suspect the new nvidia driver exposes per-device annotations that the exporter translates into labels
sre-oncall: alert fired: PROM_SERIES_RATE_HIGH (alertname=PrometheusHighSeriesRate) at 10:41. I muted the policy channel to reduce noise, leaving paging enabled
jonathan: can we quickly confirm by querying prometheus: `sum by (job) (rate(prometheus_tsdb_head_series_added_total[1m]))` — filter shows gpu-exporter job is the culprit
maria: ran `kubectl -n gpu-system get pods -l app=gpu-exporter -o wide` and `kubectl logs` on a couple — exporter shows logs: `created series from annotation gpu_device_0_uuid=...`
lee: quick mitigation: add a relabel_config to drop annotations that map to device UUIDs and driver patch level. propose: `- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_gpu_uuid] action: drop` then reload
jonathan: we can also throttle remote_write per-replica temporarily. edit prometheus remote_write config to `queue_config: max_shards: 1`/`max_samples_per_send` lower, and push a canary to staging first
sre-oncall: will implement short-term rate-limit and add relabel drop to staging, notify deploy-bot to reload prometheus config after staged validation
deploy-bot: prometheus-config reload requested by @sre-oncall via /-/reload, status: scheduled for 10:58 UTC
maria: also propose tuning the high-cardinality alert thresholds — current SLO is too sensitive for exporter churn during infra rolls. add a temporary suppression rule for exporters during node rollouts
lee: wrote a minimal relabel snippet for the daemonset service discovery (`relabel_configs`):
```
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_gpu_uuid]
  action: replace
  target_label: gpu_uuid
- action: labelmap
  regex: __meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_gpu_.*
- action: drop
  regex: gpu_uuid
```
That removes ad-hoc annotation-to-label mapping and drops uuid values
jonathan: also add a metric to detect exporter label explosion: `gpu_exporter_label_count` (gauge) and alert when a single target adds >1000 new labels/minute
sre-oncall: rolling restart of exporter daemonset scheduled after staging validation, ETA ~11:20 UTC. will keep the conversation here for timeline
maria: follow-up: after relabel and throttling applied in staging, remote_write p95 back to normal in that cluster, series_added_per_second down to baseline
lee: plan for a long-term fix: upstream exporter PR to stop auto-mapping all annotations -> labels, and add explicit allowlist; also add a preflight check in the node image rollout CI that scans for new annotations matching label rules
jonathan: can someone add a note in runbook: `gpu-exporter-cardinality.md` with rollback steps, relabel snippets, prometheus reload commands, and suppression rules? I'll create the page after we stabilize
grafana-bot: panel updated: `Prometheus -> High-cardinality events` now includes suppression window for node-rollout tag
sre-oncall: thanks all — keeping the alert open until 12:00 UTC to verify no secondary spikes. ping if you see any regressions :thumbsup:
